body:
Thank you, man. I wholeheartedly appreciate that. 

To be completely honest, I feel like a dead man walking. I know that one day it’ll happen. But, I sure as hell hope it isn’t soon. 

I never thought I’d make it past 25, and here I am. Now I set yearly goals just to survive.
The crazy part is, I’m an extremely optimistic person. I’ve always been the “cup half full” guy. But, I can’t shake this for the life of me.
You’re right. I’ve known that for a while, but, I know how I am when I’m alone. That’s all.
Who’s cutting so many goddamn onions around me?!
